title: LeeTKOB persisted job envelope, version 1
description: Internal durable queue envelope leased by a separate worker. Results echo the revision tuple and attempt fence; a stale fence or superseded revision tuple cannot commit. This is not a public HTTP route and carries no credentials.

attempt.description: Monotonically increasing lease-attempt fence; a result carrying a stale attempt cannot commit.

kind.description: judge compiles/executes and stores one verdict set; check runs hard rules and guarded semantic calls for current counted AC work.

generation.description: Counted-selection generation at enqueue time; a superseded generation cannot restore old findings.

sourceSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the submitted source bytes.
